candidates.structural_interaction: Earth generating Metal same-polarity — stability as quiet source of precision
candidates.k2_overview: Your Earth carries the Alchemist’s current: nourishment that arrives as understanding rather than comfort. This is ground that reads before it feeds, soil that turns experience over slowly until it becomes insight. It shelters you the way a library shelters, quiet, stocked, slightly apart, and it asks one rent: time alone to do the turning.
candidates.k2_functional: Thinking runs deep and sideways. You digest slowly, connect strangely, and surface with conclusions no straight line could have reached.

k2_domain_readings.Learning: Learning is where this Earth feeds you best. Not the classroom kind so much as the deep private kind: the obsession studied at midnight, the field entered through the side door. Give it one strange subject at a time. What you learn that way tends to outlast anything you learned for a grade.
k2_domain_readings.Intuition: The hunch arrives before the reason does, and for you it is usually load-bearing. Treat the sudden knowing as a first draft: trust it enough to write it down, doubt it enough to check the math by morning.
k2_domain_readings.Solitude: Time alone is this energy’s rent, and it collects whether you schedule it or not. Taken on purpose, solitude turns into your best material. Taken by accident, it curdles into distance from the people who were waiting outside the study.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, what others offer rarely settles in you. The ground you stand on is ground you dug, deep and hard to share.

angles.drive: Teaching yourself matters more to you than being taught. Needing to understand before you trust, you teach yourself from odd sources rather than take the standard lesson. What you find out this way goes deep and stays put.
angles.cost_self: Whenever you want to know something, you teach it to yourself instead of asking. Teaching yourself an answer costs you a month where being taught it costs an hour. Underneath sits a wish to owe nobody for what you know.
angles.cost_others: Rarely do you pass on the lesson you taught yourself. You taught it by a route too odd to explain, so you keep the knowing rather than tell it. Whoever learns from you gets the answer and misses the road to it.

angles.drive: You read between the lines before you finish the lines. Needing to know a thing from underneath, you trust what sits between the words over what they say. Very little gets past you, least of all what people leave unsaid.
angles.cost_self: Between the lines is where you are quickest and hardest to follow. You go with the read rather than wait for proof, so the doubt stays yours. You end up alone with hunches nobody else can see.
angles.cost_others: Whatever gets left between the lines, you read first and skip asking. Since your read lands before your question, you answer what sits under the words instead of the words. Talking to you, people get answered before they have said their piece.

angles.drive: Thinking alone is how you do your best thinking. Because you need the whole picture before you share any of it, you want the quiet more than the company. Ideas come back from those hours finished and fully yours.
angles.cost_self: After a day of company, you need an hour of thinking alone to feel yourself. You think alone to fill up rather than hide, so you guard it over sleep. That hour is the one stretch of time that belongs only to you.
angles.cost_others: Your best thinking happens alone, and you go off to it without saying how long. Once out of reach, you let the solo hours run on and lose track of the clock. The people waiting on you never know when to expect you back.

friction.define: As a friction, the holding never stops, and needing the full picture keeps you in your head. Chances to act pass while you are still taking it in.

angles.drive: You wait to feel ready rather than work to be ready, and getting ready never ends. Preparing is the part you control, and you choose another round of it over a first attempt. You are allowed to start before the feeling arrives.
angles.cost_self: Getting ready is the part you control, so it is where you stay. You lose nothing today by preparing once more, while you risk everything on a first try. You pay for each extra round in chances that closed before you felt ready.
angles.cost_others: Asked for a quick take, you hand over a prepared one later. Being ready matters more to you than being on time, so you keep people waiting. You give them the clean take late when the rough one would have done.

angles.drive: Long before anything goes wrong, you are already hard to reach. Taking things in alone, you let yourself be reached on your own schedule rather than anyone else's. You buy the quiet with friendships that wear thin.
angles.cost_self: Being reached feels like being spent, so you turn hard to reach before anything is asked. You take quiet over company until alone stops being a choice. You trade being reached for a loneliness you only feel later.
angles.cost_others: Going into your head takes you out of people's reach. Since thinking alone beats talking for you, you go a week out of reach over sending one line. You leave them guessing for a week that one line would have ended.

angles.drive: With a decision nearly made, you second-guess it from one more angle. Fearing the wrong call, you second-guess a thing rather than settle it. You usually land where your first read put you, only weeks later.
angles.cost_self: The second guess is where most of your time goes. Needing to feel certain first, you keep second-guessing a choice after the guessing stops helping. You second-guess to feel sure rather than be sure, and you lose sleep to the difference.
angles.cost_others: Second-guessing an answer you already have leaves people waiting on it. Because being certain comes first, you sit on the yes or no for weeks rather than give a maybe. You stall their next step for as long as you second-guess.
